title: 第7章 毒士凡王损招第8章 震惊小侍女一百年
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
萧凡紧接着继续向贾诩请教，他的语气中带着一丝敬佩，
“那么，先生您觉得本王接下来应该怎么做呢？”
贾诩稍稍思索后，提出建议道，“王爷不妨将自己被下毒的事情传遍整个都城，
嘿嘿！要知道，王爷在大萧皇朝可是被誉为第一少年天骄，更是武痴之名远扬。
如此一来，且看都城中的各大势力以及幕后之人如何应对？
呵呵！无论如何，王爷都是大萧皇朝萧家的嫡系子弟，他们这般行径，无疑是在狠狠地抽打皇家的脸面！”，
“再者，王爷需尽快将与镇国公府的联姻之事敲定，或许此次下毒事件也能成为推动此事的催化剂。”，
“接下来，或许就轮到王爷外出历练了，这可是大萧皇朝皇室的祖训，无人能够更改。
有了镇国公府的关系，再加上王爷武力超群，去边关历练无疑是一个绝佳的选择。”
“嗯！”先生的建议确实不错。
然而，本王想稍作改动一下，
他的脸上弥漫着冰冷的杀意，嘴角却挂着一抹似笑非笑的弧度，
“呵呵！本王被下毒已经过去这么久了，外面竟然没有丝毫动静，尤其是皇宫，宗室。”，
“看来是有人欲将本王置于死地吖！”，
“既然如此，那就遂了你们的心愿，咱凡王府也来一场别开生面的活人给活人设灵堂，上演一出薨逝的大戏如何？
并且将本王被下毒，又得白衣飘飘的老神仙赐下仙丹救命的故事改编成戏本，传遍都城，先生你觉得这个主意如何？”
听完萧凡的改动，贾诩一时间心灵惊颤，如遭雷击，
沉默了一两秒后，他连忙谄媚地拍起马屁，
“王爷真乃天命所归之子，这种高瞻远瞩、独树一帜的想法，属下实在是望尘莫及！”
心中不禁慨叹，“这等手段，当真是皇家之人所惯用！表面上看似人畜无害的武痴，实则心狠手辣，用起手段来毫不留情，简直是在逼迫某些人去铤而走险！”，

“如此甚好，本王亦觉得此改动堪称完美！”
他对着房间的阴影处喊道，“黑麒麟！”
须臾之间，
从阴影处闪出一个全身包裹得严严实实的人，如鬼魅般来到萧凡面前，毕恭毕敬地行礼道，“属下在，公子有何吩咐？”
萧凡将让黑麒麟如何假扮白衣老神仙，以及需要注意的事项一五一十地告知于他，
而后问道，“可有把握？”
黑麒麟信心满满地回答道，“公子！您尽管放心！属下定能圆满完成公子所托之事。”
言罢，便如疾风般迅速消失在黑暗之中！
坐在萧凡对面的贾诩仿若木雕泥塑一般，
他深知只需做好自己分内之事即可，王爷欲让他知晓之事，自会告知于他。
未告知之事，他亦绝不会去探听。
这才是一个好的谋士应有的素质！
萧凡笑容可掬地看向贾诩，
介绍道，“适才隐匿于黑暗中的人，名叫黑麒麟，乃是隐匿于暗处护本王周全的影子刺客，其最大的能耐便是易容之术，几乎能够以假乱真到九成九。他与先生一般，皆是大宗师级别的高手。”
贾诩满脸钦佩道，“未曾料到王爷麾下竟有如此特殊的奇才！”
content_en:
Xiao Fan then continued to ask Jia Xu for advice, with a hint of admiration in his tone,
"Then, sir, what do you think the king should do next?"
After Jia Xu thought for a moment, he suggested, "Your Majesty, you might as well spread the news about being poisoned throughout the capital.
Hehe! You know, the prince was known as the number one young genius in the Great Xiao Dynasty, and he was also known as a martial arts idiot.
In this case, let’s see how the major forces in the capital and the people behind the scenes respond?
Haha! In any case, the prince is a direct descendant of the Xiao family of the Great Xiao Dynasty. Their behavior is undoubtedly a slap in the face of the royal family! ",
"Furthermore, the prince needs to finalize the marriage with the Zhenguo government as soon as possible. Perhaps this poisoning incident can also become a catalyst for this matter.",
"Next, it may be the prince's turn to go out for training. This is the ancestral motto of the Xiao Dynasty royal family, and no one can change it.
With the relationship with the Duke of Zhenguo and the prince's superior military strength, going to the border to practice is undoubtedly an excellent choice. "
"Yeah!" The gentleman's suggestion is indeed good.
However, I would like to make a slight change,
His face was filled with cold murderous intent, but there was a hint of a smile at the corner of his mouth.
"Haha! It has been so long since the king was poisoned, and there is no movement outside, especially the palace and the clan.",
"It seems that someone wants to put this king to death!",
"In that case, let's fulfill your wish. How about we, Prince Fan, also come to the Prince's Mansion to put on a unique show where living people set up mourning halls for living people and stage a great drama of death?
And the story of the king being poisoned and being saved by an elixir given by an old fairy in white clothes was adapted into a play and spread throughout the capital. Sir, what do you think of this idea? "
After hearing Xiao Fan's changes, Jia Xu's heart trembled for a moment, as if he had been struck by lightning.
After being silent for a second or two, he quickly flattered him.
"Your Majesty is truly the son of destiny. This far-sighted and unique idea is beyond the reach of my subordinates!"
I couldn't help but sigh in my heart, "Such methods are really used by the royal family! On the surface, they appear to be harmless martial arts idiots, but in fact they are ruthless and ruthless in their methods. They are simply forcing some people to take desperate risks!",
"This is very good. I also think this change is perfect!"
He shouted into the shadows of the room, "Black Kirin!"
In a moment,
A man wrapped up tightly emerged from the shadows. He came to Xiao Fan like a ghost and saluted respectfully, "My subordinate is here. What are your orders, Master?"
Xiao Fan told him exactly how to ask Black Qilin to pretend to be an old god in white clothes, and what he needed to pay attention to.
Then he asked, "Are you sure?"
Black Qilin replied confidently, "Sir! Don't worry! I will definitely complete the tasks entrusted by you."
After saying that, he quickly disappeared into the darkness like a gust of wind!
Sitting opposite Xiao Fan, Jia Xu looks like a wood carving and clay sculpture.
He knew that all he had to do was do his part, and whatever the prince wanted him to know, he would be told.
He will never inquire about anything that has not been told to him.
These are the qualities a good counselor should have!
Xiao Fan looked at Jia Xu with a pleasant smile.
The introduction said, "The person who was hiding in the darkness just now is named Black Qilin. He is a shadow assassin who hides in the darkness to protect the king. His greatest ability is the art of disguise, and he can almost 90% confuse the fake with the real one. Like Mr., he is a master at the Grand Master level."
Jia Xu said with admiration, "I never expected that the prince would have such a special talent under his command!"
